capabilities: Run Pomodoro focus sessions that grow a tree per completed session
Build and expand a village with quests, ranks, unlocks, and neighbours
Start the timer from markdown tasks and Kanban cards
Play synthesised ambient soundscapes during focus
Log sessions to daily notes and export village snapshots as HTML
extras: Installation is manual (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css into the plugins folder); the marketplace listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; game progress lives in data.json and users are warned to back it up before uninstalling.
intentEvidence: Built upon the excellent Pomodoro Timer for Obsidian by eatgrass (MIT), which provides the core timer
motivation: The author designed it around how ADHD brains work: visual time anchoring, instant rewards, hyperfocus support, and guilt-free streaks that never punish missed days.
problem: Standard Pomodoro timers use rigid countdowns, jarring alarms, and punishing streak resets that cause shame and quitting, especially for ADHD brains.

Dataview-compatible logs recorded into your daily notes after each session

summary: ADHD-friendly Pomodoro focus timer that grows a tree per session into a village game, with Kanban boards, ambient soundscapes, and daily-note logging.
